 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Manish Choudhury
 Order

Date : 07.06.2023 Heard Mr. K.K. Mahanta, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. K.N. Mahanta,
learned counsel for the petitioner; Mr. B.J. Talukdar, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Ms. M.
Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 & 7; and Ms. N. Bordoloi, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department for the respondent no. 2.

2. Mr. Mahanta, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that in deference to the order dated 15.03.2023, the petitioner approached the office of the respondent no. 5 and completed the requisite formalities to facilitate disbursal of the amount of Rs. 2,30,38,893.00.
But the petitioner has received only an amount of Rs. 2,17,23,146.00, which is lesser than the amount the petitioner is entitled to receive.
3. Mr. Talukdar, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the afore-mentioned respondents has placed a sanction order dated 23.05.2023 of the Deputy Commissioner, Nagaon.

From the said sanction order bearing no. NRK-16/2018, it is reflected that sanction is accorded for an amount of Rs.
2,17,23,146.00 excluding Rs. 13,15,747.38 towards [i] Additional Capitalized value of Government Revenue [= Rs. 12,359.38]; [ii] Administrative Cost of establishment [5%] [= Rs. 10,86,157.00]; and [iii] Cost of Contingency [1%] [= Rs. 2,17,231.00]; for payment of land compensation towards land/building/zirat to the petitioner in connection with acquisition of land for Dr. Bhupen Hazarika Cultural Project at Kuthari, Nagaon.

The sanction order further reflects that no income tax is deducted as per provisions under Section 96 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement [RFCTLARR] Act, 2013.
